# @trysac/model-output-diff-viewer

> Render outputs of several models for the same prompts as one static, script-free HTML page with word-level diffs against a baseline model and similarity scores. TypeScript ESM library for Node.js 20+ with no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage and API

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): test files and covered edge cases
